d: Sea shore finished by the view of the nearby town of Sparta. Ships in the distance, and boats to the shore. On the Lido Trojan pavilions. In the middle of the scene, under a pergola of roses, shaped like a temple, statue of Venus. Paris, its Followers, and Trojan sailors crowned with flowers in the act of making a sacrifice to the goddess.
Love in a Spartan dress, under the name of Herastus, with Spartan Séguito, who remains in the background, and said.
Room of the real palace of Sparta with throne on one side. Elena with Séguito, and Love, and Guards.
Paris with numerous followers of Trojans, and Schiavi, who bring gifts to Elena destined, and sayings.

Great courtyard of the royal palace of Sparta surrounded by arcades, and loggias for use of gymnastics exercises. eminent place in the form of a tribune for the throne on one side. At the sound of warrior march, preceded by Spartans, Trojans, People and Guards, and by Athlete, and other Fighters, men and women to the use of Sparta. Elena, Paris, and Love.
Cabinets. Elena with a tablet in her hand folded in the shape of a letter.
Pallas in cloud; his Followers cluttering the scene, and sayings.
Paris, and Elena; and then Love.
Sea breast adjacent to the enclosure of the royal palace of Sparta. On the sea lighted Trojan ships; on the shore several boats. Night.
